title: September DMI gave no clear added Maritime Continent rain forecast skill in a 2000-2025 test
abstract: We tested whether September DMI adds information about October-December rain over 10 S-10 N, 95 E-140 E beyond September rain, Nino 3.4 and a year term. Expanding fits used earlier years from 1979 and scored 26 years in 2000-2025. Added DMI reduced mean squared error by 20.99%. The primary conditional 95% three-year block interval was -2.04% to 35.64%. RMSE fell from 0.714 to 0.634 mm/day. The gain fell to 2.84% in a smaller central box and 2.23% with August inputs. This test gives no clear added forecast skill. It does not establish a physical cause. A short record, revised and interim products, release delays and model assumptions limit inference. The package gives code, hashes, aggregate results, a figure and numerical checks. Source records and derived annual tables remain external and can be regenerated.

display.caption: Added DMI reduced point error, but the primary interval includes zero. Smaller-area and earlier-input gains were small.
